paper.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions

paper_context.research_question: Do released linear SHAP values reconstruct the explained model prediction?
paper_context.method: Fit a deterministic two-feature linear model and measure SHAP additivity residual.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Five synthetic observations under this repository's MIT license.
paper_context.training_or_inference: Closed-form linear regression and one explanation.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: Extract absolute prediction-reconstruction error; require numerical zero.
paper_context.limitations: Tests the central additivity invariant, not human-subject or large-model experiments.

claims.protocol: Extract absolute prediction-reconstruction error; require numerical zero.
